title: Nepal: three radar visits to a mountain river corridor
headline: Follow Rasuwa–Trishuli corridor, Nepal across 3 real radar observations
introduction: Three NISAR observations show the Rasuwa–Trishuli study area on 19 August, 31 August and 6 October 2026. These frames use track 098, frame 016, selected after checking the actual satellite footprints and valid raster masks across the requested area.
conclusion: Use the baseline comparison to inspect persistent river-corridor and mountain-surface patterns. Shadow, layover, snow and ice complicate mountain radar. These views do not independently confirm a collapse mechanism or delineate the full debris-flow footprint.

properties.name: Nepal: a mountain collapse becomes a downstream flood
properties.role: User-requested search rectangle; not a flood boundary

method: NISAR, consistent polarization and orbit per story. Source calibrated power converted using 10*log10 where necessary; existing dB sources are not converted again. Bilinear alignment to the first grid, invalid/nonpositive power masked, fixed viridis −30 to +5 dB display. Statistics are radar response, not classified flood area.
